snippet.title: "Breaking Up Is Hard To Do" Announce Trailer - "I don't agree to that"
snippet.description:
In this visual novel, you want to break up with your girlfriend, but she doesn't want to break up with you!  Will you tell her the hard truths or try to let her down easy?  Turns out, sometimes breaking up is hard to do!

Wishlist "Breaking Up Is Hard To Do" on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4412380/Breaking_Up_Is_Hard_To_Do
